title: Implement Teaching Reconciliation on Session Events
description: Add automatic reconciliation trigger for teach files on: (1) New session start - detect .teaching files, show briefing, propose adoption, (2) WAI wakeup hook - list pending teachings, (3) Closeout - process taught files into reference/auto, reconcile with current versions, prompt for adoption decisions. Success: Users see pending teachings on session start and can adopt or defer.
resolution_reason: Implemented teaching reconciliation on session start, wakeup, and closeout; added teach adopt subcommand. Testing to be addressed as separate task.
